title: Health data platform: replace Health Dashboard.xlsx with health-cli store + generated workbook
description: Source of truth moves from ~/desk/Personal/Medical/Health Dashboard.xlsx into an encrypted fsqlite store owned by health-cli; the workbook becomes generated output. Labs stay in biomarker-cli, genotypes in genome-cli.

title: health-cli: fsqlite data model, encrypted store, one-time xlsx import
description: Rust crate matching biomarker-cli/genome-cli conventions (fsqlite, XChaCha20 sealed container unlocked by ~/.ssh/id_ed25519, audit log, versioned JSON envelope health/v1, table/json/jsonl/csv output). Tables: supplement, product, source/protocol, dose schedule, nutrition item, routine step, workout exercise, vaccine/condition, provider/physical, size, resource, paper/evidence ref (kd Work id + stance). Import every non-lab sheet of Health Dashboard.xlsx read-only. Acceptance: import produces the DB at the default data dir; row counts match the sheet (Supplements 87, Products 45, Nutrition 66, Routine 36).

title: health-cli: generate Health Dashboard workbook with rust_xlsxwriter
description: health sheet --out FILE builds the full workbook from the store + biomarker --format json + genome JSON. Excel-native formulas only (no Google __xludf.DUMMYFUNCTION), tables, conditional formats, data validation, charts. Parity with the original sheets first, then smart features from the ideas catalog.
